sources.title_en: Multiple redirect URIs and token refresh for OAuth apps
sources.title_original: Multiple redirect URIs and token refresh for OAuth apps
sources.summary:
We’ve released multiple updates to the OAuth app and GitHub App platforms to support more secure app development: OAuth apps can opt in to expiring access tokens and refresh tokens.…
We’ve released multiple updates to the OAuth app and GitHub App platforms to support more secure app development:
OAuth apps can now request a short-lived token during the user authentication flow. If an app opts in, they get an access token that lives for eight hours and a refresh token that’s valid for six months.
sources.recommend_reason_zh: GitHub为OAuth应用推出八小时短期访问令牌与六个月刷新令牌，并支持注册最多10个redirect URIs，新增通配符匹配但需警惕滥用风险。

items.title: Claude 文本水印机制如何运作 / How Claude's text watermark works

sources.title: Claude 文本水印机制如何运作 / How Claude's text watermark works
sources.title_zh: Claude 文本水印机制如何运作
sources.title_en: How Claude's text watermark works
sources.title_original: How Claude's text watermark works
sources.summary: 未来 Claude 模型生成的文本将包含水印，用于判断文本由 Claude 撰写的可能性，这是 Anthropic 为遵守欧盟《AI 法案》而实施的变更。该方法基于 Google DeepMind 的 SynthID-Text 技术，对输出质量、创造力和可读性无实际影响，读者无法区分水印文本与普通文本，且不增加额外 token 或成本。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 本文详解Claude新增文本水印机制：借用随机选词中的低风险选择嵌入密钥模式，可判定文本是否由Claude生成，且不影响输出，主要为了遵守欧盟AI法案。

sources.summary: Not a fan of ThoughtDAG being a complete separate application rather than built into the tools I use every day, like my text editor or other planning tool. But neat that you've seemingly integrated a bunch of LLM providers, including letting us use local models, pretty neat :) Some security "nitpicks": I'm fairly sure you have a critical security issue in the "execSync(`pdftoppm -png -r ${dpi} ...`)" call you do, which I don't think would have been a issue if the local web server you start liste
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这篇HN评论给ThoughtDAG泼了盆冷水：虽然它集成多家LLM并支持本地模型，但服务器绑定0.0.0.0且用execSync执行pdftoppm，任何人可借此在运行者电脑上执行命令，另指出AppImage未签名且使用--no-sandbox，安全问题值得开发者优先处理。
